subject: Request: post-period continuity statement + supporting evidence for Auriga Systems
messages:
From: Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@aurigasys.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aurigasys.com, security@aurigasys.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Post-report continuity statement and evidence needed for vendor review

Hi Sean,

Auriga's security and procurement teams are kicking off a vendor reassessment ahead of our Q2 deployment. We have your SOC 2 Type II report that ends 2025-12-31 on file, but our policy requires a brief post-period continuity statement (sometimes called a "bridge" or "continuity statement") to cover the period between the report end date and the present.

What we need from Redwood:
- A short continuity statement covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-01 that confirms there were no control exceptions or material changes impacting the scope of the SOC 2 report, or documents and explains any exceptions.
- A signed management assertion or equivalent (pdf).
- A concise list of any changes to security controls/processes since 2025-12-31 (bullet list; dates and owners).
- Supporting artifacts: latest patch/compliance summary for endpoints, a current access-control change log for privileged accounts, and confirmation of any subservice provider changes.

Timing: Procurement needs these materials for their vendor packet by 2026-03-10. If you can provide a draft continuity statement and attachments by 2026-03-01, that should give us time to include it.

Attach: We will need the final signed copy (PDF). Also note our security team may follow up with a short set of clarifying questions after review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if easier.

Best,
Evelyn Park
Senior Security Program Manager
Auriga Systems
evelyn.park@aurigasys.com

---
Attachment: vendor-security-questionnaire-auriga-req.pdf (procurement checklist)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Draft continuity statement (Auriga) + proposed redlines

Folks — attached is a draft continuity statement prepared for Auriga based on the artifacts Monica provided and our standard template. Highlights:
- Report end date: 2025-12-31
- Continuity coverage requested: 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-01
- We assert that there were no material control exceptions during the period relevant to the SOC 2 report scope. Where relevant, we cite minor operational updates (e.g., rotation of a third-party monitoring vendor on 2026-01-28) that did not affect control performance.

Open items / redlines for review:
1) Signature: Redwood generally signs continuity statements via a senior executive (CEO or Head of Security). For speed, recommend Head of Security (Monica) sign; Marissa to coordinate final signature.
2) Language around "to the best of management's knowledge": Legal prefers adding "to the best of management's knowledge" to soften absolute representations. Procurement clients sometimes push back on that phrasing — Sean, please let me know Auriga's position.
3) Data retention sentence: Auriga procurement asked about retention policies; we included a single-sentence summary with a link to our data retention FAQ rather than attaching full policy. Auriga may request the complete retention policy; if so we can share the policy under an NDA.

Attached: Draft_Bridge_Letter_Auriga_20260301.pdf, Mgmt_Assertion_20260301.pdf (unsigned)

If you authorize, I will: 
- finalize the wording with the "to the best of management's knowledge" insertion as a fallback,
- route for signature (Monica/Head of Security preferred),
- send final package to Auriga with DocuSign for signature.

Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / Sean — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the draft package. Procurement and security reviewed the attachments and have two quick asks before we can include the documents in our vendor packet:

1) In the continuity statement, can you soften the data retention sentence slightly — current wording implies a 5-year retention for all logs. Can you confirm retention for audit logs and security logs specifically and change to: "audit logs retained in accordance with Redwood Inference's data retention policy (audit logs retained for a minimum of X months)"? That will align to our audit team templates.

2) We need the final management assertion executed (PDF) and the continuity statement signed via DocuSign. If you can provide DocuSign by EOD 2026-03-04, procurement can close the vendor packet.

If it's helpful, I've attached our procurement review form with the redlines highlighted. We do not require additional technical artifacts beyond the patching summary and access-control change log you already shared, but security may reach out with one or two clarifying questions after signature.

Procurement contact for the final packet: procurement@aurigasys.com (please cc them on the signed copy).

Appreciate the collaboration — we can jump on a short call if you prefer to finalize language quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Park

Auriga Systems
